<!-- pr-reviewer: 3e89ffb71517948b630b8c39647b463e48ebfe0b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good
- The change is in `crates/ui` only. No app, motion, post or generator file changed, so posted wire EDM G-code does not change. The `.nc` and `.cl` goldens are untouched.
- The Passes tab edits the draft. Apply uses the existing undoable `EditOperationParams` command. Validation stays in `WireContourOp::is_sane` and the command door. The test `wire_skims_add_reorder_remove_and_apply_undo` checks that one undo restores the old list.
- Layering holds: ui imports from `camcraft_app::operation` only.
- Add skim stops at `SKIMS_MAX`. A condition that the machine no longer states stays visible and unchanged.
- The tests are in a new file with a provenance line and a Gate map. No snapshot PNG changed. No Cargo file changed. The decision file is present.

## Results merged with main (local, Windows)
- Trial merge with `origin/main`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- wire` from `crates/ui`: 12 passed, 0 failed. This includes the 6 new pins and `structural::wire_machine_editor_structure`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. `wire_page.rs` line "t.at.len() < 1024" repeats the limit in `WireTabs::is_sane`. A named constant exported from app would stop drift.
2. `structural.rs` is not changed. The new kittest file checks the labels and the enabled state instead.
3. `docs/review/1765/validate.py` was read and not run. It is an evidence helper and is not part of the product.
4. Not exercised: the full ui suites, a real wire EDM machine, and the snapshot lanes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
